verdicts.reason: A shrinks the Q logo to an illegible speck at the bottom corner of a large empty dark block, so the brand mark is effectively lost and the panel reads as dead space. B keeps the logo large and legible in the dark panel, but its orange divider cuts through the 'Rosemary' line of the headline. Both cram the body copy, CTA and legal into the bottom strip with tiny text and a small button.
